name: Iron Aurora
look: a robot Articuno with a starry cyan glass belly, a grid visor and starry crest, V-raised wings of cyan and deep blue feathers on segmented steel arms and a long starry tail ending in a white banded tip
entry: A Pokémon resembling Articuno, sketched in a report about lights that danced over a frozen sea on a starless night. A galaxy swirls behind the glass of its belly, and its wings scatter frost that glows like an aurora.
how: Wild: very rare at night on frozen peaks and glaciers.
